Patrick Bet-David sits down with historian Victor Davis Hanson for a wide-ranging conversation on what happens if America loses its place in the world. Hanson breaks down immigration, Europe’s future, Iran, Israel, the limits of American power, the Founders, farming, and the five forces he believes could threaten America’s future.
